scope: Not Done Yet application follow-up: apply form and FAQ, immediate Beehiiv outbox, personal next-step screen, Sarah inquiry logging, application board and private delivery view. Shared analytics are disabled only on the personal action page.

sections.readerQuestion: What happens when I submit my coaching application?
sections.usefulAnswer: With the feature enabled, the saved application offers immediate next steps, with a Beehiiv email and a choice to join or ask Sarah. Existing manual copy remains while disabled.
sections.evidence: Anthony requested an immediate two-option flow on 8 September 2026. The server flag gates both the transactional implementation and visible copy. The API keeps Inner Circle on the existing path.
sections.editorialDecision: Replace the contradictory 48-hour promise only when the new flow is enabled. Preserve existing offer and trial copy elsewhere.

sections.readerQuestion: How do I join, or ask about the coaching before paying?
sections.usefulAnswer: Open the Skool about page or the monthly coaching selection; submit one short question linked to the existing application and Sarah.
sections.evidence: User specified $195 USD/month. Skool public search confirms the programme price. About destination verified from existing site and Skool references. Actual checkout selection and personalised email links still require live QA.
sections.editorialDecision: Keep two clear actions and visible pricing. Avoid countdowns, invented scarcity, member counts or unsupported benefits. Fit cases needing discussion receive honest wording.

sections.location: Application API, database outbox, Beehiiv adapter, cron and notification sender
sections.readerQuestion: Will applications and questions survive a delivery problem?
sections.usefulAnswer: The job commits with the application. Saved questions commit before notification. Known failures have bounded retries, while uncertain Beehiiv enrollment stops for inspection.
sections.evidence: Focused tests cover enrollment request failures, opt-outs, durable marker ordering, duplicate action handling, stage preservation and sender boundaries. Database calls are mocked; real transaction concurrency has not been tested here.
sections.editorialDecision: Use precise statuses such as Beehiiv accepted, not delivered. Keep checkout intent separate from confirmed payment. No changes to Skool memberships or payments.

sections.readerQuestion: Who needs a reply and did the automation run?
sections.usefulAnswer: Questions for Sarah stage, saved question text, email enrollment status, Sarah notification state and safe failed-delivery retries are visible behind existing admin authentication.
sections.evidence: Existing Sarah address and owner slug verified from the repository. The new board stage is included in reporting totals and stage normalization. Source checks and TypeScript cover integration; rendered admin QA remains pending.
sections.editorialDecision: Use neutral existing admin colors and expose useful outcomes without claiming provider inbox delivery.

sections.location: Shared analytics bootstrap, consent runtimes and attribution capture
sections.readerQuestion: Does my personal application link remain private?
sections.usefulAnswer: The personal follow-up page suppresses analytics and marketing runtimes and does not send its URL fragment to the application attribution collector.
sections.evidence: Existing Google page-view code used window.location.href. The private route now omits the Google bootstrap and optional runtimes even with consent. Focused rendering tests verify the exclusion and preserve ordinary page bootstrap.
sections.editorialDecision: Scope the exclusion to /apply/next, keep tokens in fragments and POST bodies, and retain noindex and no-referrer metadata.

claimsAndSources: The price and requested two-option workflow come from Anthony. Sarah email is confirmed in repository team configuration. Beehiiv API and merge-tag documentation were consulted. No performance, purchase, subscriber-count or medical outcome is claimed.
examplesAndReasoning: No training prescriptions or case-result examples were added. The suitability screen is an explicit deterministic routing rule. Supported goals and time receive a fit message; injury/comeback, low-time and unknown-goal cases receive discussion wording.
voiceAndCuts: Removed the enabled-flow 48-hour holding message and generic nothing-else-to-do confirmation. The next step is a direct join or question choice with the price visible. No invented urgency or absolute suitability claim.
desktopReview: Pending: browser can read Beehiiv pages but interaction controls time out. The application and admin screens have not yet completed rendered desktop QA. No visual pass is asserted.
mobileReview: Pending: no verified mobile viewport review of the new flow or received email is available in this session. Publication remains held until actual rendered checks complete.
productAndOfferAccuracy: Not Done Yet coaching is $195 USD/month as explicitly specified by Anthony and publicly listed by Skool. About link is grounded. Plans route appears in search but selected checkout and email merge URLs require live verification before activation. Existing trial copy is preserved; this new email does not introduce a trial claim.
